title: Script editor caret unexpectedly jumps to the first function while typing
body:
### Tested versions

Script editor caret unexpectedly jumps to the first function while typing

Script editor caret unexpectedly jumps to the first function while typing

Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot 4.8.dev4

Not reproducible in: a separate project with a much shorter script

Issue description

While typing in the GDScript editor, the text caret unexpectedly jumps to the beginning of the first function in the script.

This happens repeatedly while I am editing the script and makes it difficult to continue typing normally.

The script where I noticed the issue is approximately 800 lines long.

I tested a much shorter script in another project, and I could not reproduce the issue there.

Expected behavior

The text caret should remain at the position where I am currently typing unless I intentionally move it.

Actual behavior

The text caret unexpectedly moves to the beginning of the first function while I am typing.

Steps to reproduce

1. Open the project in Godot 4.8.dev4.
2. Open the large GDScript file.
3. Start typing/editing the script.
4. Continue editing for a while.
5. Observe that the caret may unexpectedly jump to the first function.

Additional information

I have not confirmed whether the issue is caused by the size of the script. The issue was observed in a script of approximately 800 lines, but I could not reproduce it in a separate project with a shorter script.

A screen recording is attached showing the behavior.

### System information

Android 11-Godot 4.8 dev4
